CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSTimeFormat

Returns the time part of a date/time value as a string, using the conventions of the current locale. The mask characters are the same as for TimeFormat.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSTimeFormat(time [, mask ])

Parameters

time
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.
mask
Optional. A TimeFormat mask such as "HH:mm:ss", or one of the named formats short, medium and long. The default is hh:mm tt.

Returns

The formatted time as a string.

Usage

KoldFusion formats in English (US) only (see SetLocale), so LSTimeFormat gives the same result as TimeFormat.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET T = CreateTime(16, 5, 30)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Locale: #GetLocale()#</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Mask</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>(none)</TD><TD>#LSTimeFormat(T)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>short</TD><TD>#LSTimeFormat(T, "short")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>medium</TD><TD>#LSTimeFormat(T, "medium")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>HH:mm</TD><TD>#LSTimeFormat(T, "HH:mm")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

TimeFormat, LSDateFormat, LSParseDateTime, SetLocale
